snippet.title: Titan Crew · Early Access Trailer · Co-op, 1 to 4 players · Dec 3 on Steam
snippet.description:
Titan Crew is a co-op game for 1 to 4 players. You bring the MULE back into service: a 27-metre walking machine that sat in its depot for ten years. Cold-start it by hand, one generator group at a time, keep it running with its 112-page onboard manual, and walk it across an abandoned valley. No combat. Bearings whistle, pumps suck gravel, a foot slips in the mud, and the crew has to get it back up.

Early Access on Steam: Thursday 3 December 2026, 10am PST / 7pm CET. $9.99 / 9,99 € / 1,400 ¥, 20% off for the first two weeks.
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5551730/Titan_Crew/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_en

Made by one person in France. The radio voices and the music are AI-generated, and an AI assistant helped with the code and the text. Full disclosure on the Steam page.

日本語：1〜4人の協力ゲーム。高さ27メートルの歩行機械を、仲間と一緒に動かします。UI・字幕・112ページのマニュアルは日本語対応。12月4日（金）午前3時、Steamで早期アクセス開始。

Français : jeu coop de 1 à 4 joueurs, en accès anticipé sur Steam le jeudi 3 décembre à 19 h.

Site: https://titan-crew.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/qZ6PMjn3x6
X: https://x.com/titancrew_game
